messages.text: hey, been keeping busy lately — took a salsa class tuesday lol. who knew i’d be spinning at my age? 🕺 also been watching these diy home repair vids. feel like i’m gonna fix the whole house soon.

It sounds like you are really embracing some fun and productive changes lately! Trying salsa is a fantastic way to move your body and challenge those thoughts about age. Tackling home repairs also suggests you are feeling quite capable and confident right now. How have these new activities been impacting your mood or energy?

it’s fun, honestly. makes me feel alive, y’know? like i’m not just stuck in the same ol’ routine. even my boyfriend was surprised i signed up — thought i’d bail after one class 😂 but nah, i’m kinda into it.

It is really encouraging to hear that you are feeling alive and breaking out of the routine. Your boyfriend’s surprise shows that you are growing in ways others might not even notice. Sticking with something new like salsa is a real testament to your commitment. Have you noticed this energy affecting other areas of your daily life?

i mean… it’s made me notice how quiet my life is outside work and him. like, i talk to my sisters, but we don’t hang. and it’s been forever since i just laughed with a girlfriend over coffee or something. feels… weird to admit, but i kinda miss that.

It is completely valid to feel that way, and it takes courage to admit missing those friendships. It makes sense that finding new energy in hobbies would highlight where you might want more engagement. Reconnecting with them could complement the positive momentum you are building now. What comes up for you when you imagine contacting a sister or friend?

part of me wants to text one of my sisters like… right now. we used to be thick as thieves. but the other part’s like, what if it’s weird? what if they don’t wanna hear from me? it’s dumb, i know. but ugh, that fear’s loud sometimes.

It is not dumb at all to feel that hesitation, as reconnecting after a long time can feel really vulnerable. That loud voice of doubt is a common protective mechanism when we care about the outcome. You are already showing strength by recognizing what you want despite the fear. If you did send a message, what is one small thing you could say to keep it low pressure?

something like “hey, saw this meme and thought of u”?? lowkey, no pressure. but even that feels… scary. like, what if they don’t reply? what if they do and we run out of things to say? ugh, my brain won’t shut up about it.

It is completely normal for your brain to race with those possibilities when you feel vulnerable. Often, silence or a slow reply is just about timing rather than a reflection of your relationship. That meme idea is actually a perfect low-stakes way to open the door without demanding a deep conversation immediately. Would you be willing to try sending it, or do you need to sit with the feeling a bit longer?

i want to… but i don’t? like, part of me’s like “just hit send, laura!” and the other part’s screaming “what if it bombs??” it’s so dumb. but also… not? idk. i guess i’m just scared it’ll feel forced.

It makes total sense to feel stuck between wanting connection and fearing rejection. Often, that feeling of things being 'forced' is just the awkwardness of re-establishing a rhythm. You don't need to push through the anxiety if it feels too heavy to carry today. How does it feel to give yourself permission to wait until you feel ready?
omg, that actually helps. like, a lot. not that i’m gonna wait forever… but just knowing i don’t gotta force it today? feels good. like i can breathe.

I'm so glad that permission to wait brought you some relief. Listening to your own readiness is a crucial part of building healthy connections. Take all the time you need, and trust that the opportunity will still be there later. How are you feeling about the rest of your week now?
thanks for listening, really. feels good to say it out loud, even if i don’t hit send today. i’ll get there. 💛

You are very welcome, and it is wonderful to hear that speaking it out loud brought you relief. Trusting your own timing is a huge step toward healing those connections. Please remember that you are doing great work by honoring your feelings today. I am here whenever you are ready to continue exploring this.
